wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Wall tile substrate preparation and feature tile alignment
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 墙砖基层准备与特色砖对齐

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Wall tiling can create a practical finish or a feature surface. We assess the wall lining, existing coating and the proposed tile size and weight before confirming preparation. Tiles should not simply cover a loose, damaged or unsuitable wall base.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 墙砖可提供实用饰面或特色墙。确认准备前评估墙衬、旧涂层及拟用砖尺寸重量；不应直接覆盖松动、损坏或不适合的墙面基层。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: The layout considers the wall dimensions, visible cuts, corners and terminations. Large-format tiles, small formats and patterns place different demands on the base and set-out, so send the selected tile details if you have them. Specific material suitability is confirmed for the job rather than assumed.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 排布考虑墙面尺寸、可见切砖、转角与终止位置。大砖、小砖及图案对基层和排布要求不同，如已有选择请提供资料。具体适用性按项目确认，不作假定。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 。台面及插座周边请查看我们的

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Wall substrate, tile weight and edge finishes
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 墙面基层、瓷砖重量与边缘收口

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Wall lining, paint or existing tiles and required preparation.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 墙衬、涂漆或旧砖及所需准备。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Selected tile dimensions, weight and layout.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 所选砖尺寸、重量及排布。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Cut positions, exposed edges and junction finishes.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 切割位置、外露边缘与交接收口。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Whether the wall is internal, external or exposed to water.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 墙面在室内、室外还是接触水。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Electrical, plumbing or structural changes are separate trade scopes, confirmed before installation.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 电气、管道或结构改动为独立工种，安装前确认。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Old paint, adhesive residues and damaged wall lining can affect the suitability of the base. We assess what needs removal or preparation and whether the wall can support the proposed tile size and weight. A new tiled surface should not conceal unresolved dampness or a loose coating. The quote identifies the accessible wall area and any lining work included.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 旧漆、残胶和损坏墙衬影响基层适用性。我们评估需去除或准备的内容，以及墙面是否能支撑拟用砖尺寸和重量。新砖不应遮盖未解决潮湿或松动涂层。报价明确可接触墙面及包含的墙衬工作。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Feature tile alignment and visible edges
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 特色砖对齐与可见边缘

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: The selected format changes the balance of cuts at corners, openings and terminations. Share tile dimensions and the intended pattern so we can agree alignment, edge trims and visible cuts before installation. Fittings and outlets need a coordinated sequence with the relevant trades. For wet walls, membrane preparation is confirmed separately from the decorative or practical tile finish.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 所选规格影响转角、开口与终止处切割的均衡。提供尺寸和图案，安装前确认对齐、收口条与可见切砖。装置和插座需与相关工种协调。湿墙膜层准备与装饰或实用瓷砖饰面分别确认。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Tell us which wall will be tiled, its existing finish and any selected tile size or format. We check the base, tile weight and edge details.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 说明铺哪面墙、现有饰面和已选砖尺寸规格，我们检查基层、重量与边缘。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Fittings, corners and adjoining surfaces guide the cuts and layout; product details can follow the first enquiry.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 装置、转角及相邻表面影响切割排布；产品资料可在首次咨询后补充。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Assess the accessible surface, its condition and the intended finish.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 评估可接触表面、现状及期望饰面。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Confirm preparation, material responsibility, boundaries and access in a written scope.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 书面确认准备、材料责任、边界与通行。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Prepare the base and complete the agreed installation or joint renewal, coordinating connected work.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 准备基层，完成约定安装或接缝更新，并协调关联工作。

wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Explain cleaning, curing and return to use at handover. Timing follows the selected materials and site conditions.
wall-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 交付时说明清洁、养护及恢复使用，时间依材料和现场条件确定。
